claim: Open-weight models trail frontier models by roughly 3-6 months on most benchmarks, with the cost break-even for local deployment landing between 5-15 million tokens per day.
quote: open-weight models tend to be roughly 3-6 months behind frontier on most benchmarks ... the breakeven is somewhere between 5-15 million tokens per day

claim: Self-hosting on a single H100 breaks even around 256M tokens/month vs premium GPT-5-class APIs but only at 60-70% sustained utilization; at 10% utilization real cost per token is 10x the headline rate.
quote: closer to 256 million tokens per month ... 60-70% sustained GPU utilization ... H100 at 10% utilization: roughly $0.13 per 1K tokens (10x penalty) ... The GPU bills the same whether it is running at 100% or 5%

claim: Hidden self-hosting costs add a 3-5x multiplier over raw GPU rental, covering DevOps labor (~$145K/year) and model update cycles.
quote: Infrastructure overhead adds 3-5x multiplier beyond raw GPU rental ... DevOps labor (~$145K/year), model updates (~$12K each)

claim: Most consumer LLM APIs are not HIPAA Business Associates, so sending PHI through free-tier ChatGPT, Claude.ai, or Gemini is a reportable breach; private inference also requires AES-256 encryption, access controls, and audit logging.
quote: Free-tier ChatGPT, free-tier Claude.ai, free-tier Gemini ... do not come with a BAA, and sending PHI through them is a reportable breach ... data encrypted at rest (AES-256)

claim: Frontier APIs offer only limited customization (system prompts, constrained fine-tuning) while open-source enables full SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, and custom RLHF; frontier models also create vendor lock-in whereas open models offer zero proprietary dependency and full portability.

claim: Regulated-industry deployments use HIPAA/SOC2/GDPR playbooks where self-hosted open-weight models in a private VPC with no internet egress are the straightforward compliant path for PHI and EU personal data.
quote: LLM Deployment in Regulated Industries: The HIPAA, SOC2 & GDPR Playbook for 2026

claim: Frontier API providers showed sudden 42% latency increases within single Q1 2026 reporting windows, making hardcoded single-vendor lock-in a primary technical risk and favoring multi-provider gateways.
